IMPORTANT NOTICE: STRICT ATTENTION REQUIRED

Kindly read and strictly adhere to the following policies.

Professional Conduct & Communication Policy

All students are required to demonstrate professionalism, courtesy and respect towards SMS-USCE Administration and its representatives at all times.

Students are entitled to seek clarification and raise legitimate concerns; however, disrespectful language, abusive communication and unprofessional conduct will not be tolerated.

All enquiries and concerns must be directed through the designated Questions & Concerns section of the Student Portal.

Students are expected to adhere to these professional standards throughout their engagement with SMS-USCE.

Refund Policy

Registration fees are non-refundable once a student's portal has been activated and accessed, subject to applicable law.

SMS-USCE reserves the right to discontinue services in cases of disrespectful, abusive or unprofessional conduct, subject to the applicable terms and refund policy.

As SMS-USCE serves numerous students, professionalism, cooperation and adherence to established procedures are essential to maintaining efficient service delivery.

Payment Policy

All payments made through MTN Mobile Money must include the applicable transaction charges.

Students are required to include the additional 10% payment charge when making payments to SMS-USCE.

Payments that do not cover the required amount and applicable charges will remain unverified until the outstanding balance has been settled.

Kindly ensure that all payment details are accurate before completing any transaction.

SMS-USCE Administration

Information Centre · Visa & Elective Payments

Official U.S. visa processing begins February 1, 2027.

Passport application$171 · approximately GH₵2,010For students who do not already have a passport.
U.S. visa application fee$185 · approximately GH₵2,175
Visa appointment scheduling service$350 · approximately GH₵4,114

Payments may be made in four equal installments of 25% each, allowing students to pay 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of the total fee over time. Visa-related payments should be completed by February 2027.

Elective fees may be paid in installments until October 29, 2027.

A 50% elective deposit is required to secure an invitation letter and must be available at least seven days before your visa interview.

STUDENTS ARE PRIORITISED ON A FIRST-COME, FIRST-SERVED BASIS. ALL REQUIRED PASSPORT AND VISA-RELATED FEES MUST BE PAID IN FULL BEFORE VISA PROCESSING CAN BEGIN.

Ghana cedi equivalents are based on the current exchange rate per US$1 and may vary as exchange rates change.

Questions & Concerns

Professional enquiries only. Submit questions that are significant and directly relevant to your U.S. clinical rotation, visa preparation, or travel arrangements. Unrelated or inappropriate messages will not be attended to.
